notes.title: Mortal Blitz has a new update!
notes.content:
Hello Users of Steam! This is from Skonec Entertainment, the developer of Mortal Blitz. 

With today's update, gamers can enjoy Mortal Blitz more restfully and enjoyably.

1.  Enhanced the effect when activating Advanced CPU Featured.
 : The effect became more splendid when the Advanced CPU Featured was
   activated.
   The image quality was improved by adding multiple light source effects.
   In addition, we added a variety of items in the game to enhance immersion
   and reality.

2.  Fixed a problem which ‘Chaperone System’ did not work properly.
 : In previous version, there were several errors due to the narrow range of 
   the Chaperone.
   With this patch, the range of the Chaperone was further expanded.
   So, gamers can enjoy the game more pleasantly and safely than before.

3.  Part of sounds are improved.
 : Fire sound and Hurt sound were improved.
   From now, Gamers are able to enjoy the game more dynamically than 
   before.

We are very grateful to those who enjoy our game, and we are working to provide additional contents to you soon.

Thank you for playing Mortal Blitz.

notes.title: Mortal Blitz is Released! with 10% Launch Discount
notes.content:
Mortal Blitz is a VR FPS game that maximizes the smashing excitement and sense of hitting. 

It has been already released in PlayStation VR Store, and has received warm welcome by users in North America, Europe, Asia and achieved the Most sold PSVR game in the respective stores. 

Interaction with the A.G.C.S, 
The Dodge/Cover system where you can actually MOVE,
Stylish fighting style where you can float your enemies into air and shoot them in the air,
You can enjoy these unique and thrilling features, which you can only feel with in VR itself. 

Also, launching discount of 10 % is ongoing right now, so we hope you can have a great, fun experience with Mortal Blitz.

Thank you!
